mentions.name: Smart Notes
mentions.description: An Anki extension that lets users flexibly fill out card fields with AI-generated text, speech, and images, such as generating example sentences for an entire deck or adding furigana to kanji. It aims to be the most well-designed, intuitive, and stable Anki extension, balancing flexible content generation for any subject with an approachable, discoverable interface.
mentions.audience: Works for language learners as well as medical students and other Anki users, including younger marginal users with varying levels of English ability.
mentions.source_excerpt:
I’ve been hacking on a single Anki extension for… the last three years now:

https://smart-notes.xyz

The idea is to make an extension that allows you to flexibly fill out fields on your cards with AI generated text, speech, and images. Think generating example sentences for your entire deck, or adding furigana to kanji (small phonetic characters with a very delicate syntax).
